name: GitHub Code Reviews
description: Review GitHub pull requests: read diffs, leave inline comments, and submit reviews.
examples: Review the diff on this pull request and leave inline comments
Request changes on this PR with line-by-line notes
Approve this pull request once it looks good
long_description: Use the GitHub Code Reviews plugin to review pull requests as the code-reviews bot: fetch PR diffs, post line-by-line inline comments, and submit reviews that approve, request changes, or comment. This identity reviews others' pull requests rather than opening feature work of its own.
